entries.desc: DONE cleanup resolves worktreeRoot via git top-level, so nested cwd uses .worktrees/B-xxx as wtPathAbs rather than .worktrees/B-xxx/PVSC.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm run test:worktree-authority-smoke
evidence.note: Build and smoke passed after moving the DONE linked-worktree branch guard before checkMainDivergence/autoSyncMain; nested DONE cleanup still resolves the canonical git top-level root.

entries.desc: git add/commit of DONE metadata runs from the canonical worktree root, so main receives index.json phase DONE after merge even when command was invoked from a child directory.

evidence.note: Smoke confirms DONE metadata still commits and merges from the canonical story worktree root on the correct story/B-9e48-style branch.

entries.desc: If cwd is inside a story worktree but not itself the registered worktree root, Koala must not rm -rf the nested cwd as cleanup target.

evidence.note: Smoke now makes wrong linked branches behind main and verifies Koala rejects before auto-sync can merge main or mutate the linked worktree.

entries.desc: worktree-authority smoke has a nested-cwd DONE regression case that passes on the fixed cleanup path.

evidence.note: worktree-authority smoke passed with the nested-cwd DONE regression plus the new wrong-branch and non-story behind-main regression cases.

entries.desc: The regression asserts the story branch is deleted and git worktree list no longer contains the story worktree root after DONE from nested cwd.

evidence.note: Wrong story branch smoke records a main-only commit after checkout and asserts that commit is not an ancestor of story/B-other after DONE rejection.

entries.desc: The regression would fail if cleanup output/target uses the PVSC child directory or leaves main metadata at TEST.

evidence.note: Non-story branch smoke records a main-only commit after checkout and asserts feature/not-story neither receives the file nor absorbs main before rejection.
